mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 5% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with corporate earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO YoY < -2% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 does not correlate with increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with corporate earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ < -1% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.
